prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval grounded RPG LOW RES PIXEL ART location concept, elevated three-quarter cutaway. Coarse square pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, restrained 3-tone stone timber wool iron, muted earth palette, no smooth painted surfaces or photorealism. No people, no text or labels, no quest UI, no magic, no outcome animation. Daylight. Room/prop geometry is a proposal, not certified collision, official geography, inventory or narrative outcome. Open ordinary return path remains visually distinct. TWO independent side-by-side panels. LEFT small private conversation room in soot-grey brick building, personally operable open door leads straight outside; two separated simple stools, a CLOSED travel bundle owned by the absent returnee and one closed unsent folded recruitment paper on a small table. No war trophies, no heroic mural, no forced testimony. RIGHT heat-work changing shed, empty with simple privacy screen away from two clear exterior doorways; separate short drying rails carry a few damp work garments, a small ordinary UNLIT pendant on a dry shelf away from them. A clean water jug on exterior dry ground, no mixing with furnace canal, no person undressing or exposed body. No cure, returnee unveiling possessions, employment commitment or belief verdict.
